title: Zero-Uncertainty States Relative to Observable Algebras
summary: We study zero-uncertainty states with quantum memory from an operator-algebraic perspective, which naturally accommodates degenerate projective-valued measurements. In the equal-dimension setting, we prove a rigidity theorem for purity and maximal entanglement. We then analyze two mechanisms by which this rigidity can fail: one arising from proper observable subalgebras, and the other from allowing larger memory dimensions.
